_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers (committed, shared with the team). GitHub and Context7 are already connected via the claude.ai account, so they are NOT redefined here. The servers below are a documented scaffold — they are DISABLED until you move them into 'mcpServers' and ensure the required runtime exists in the devcontainer. This container currently has no node/npx or uv/uvx; install one (e.g. add Node to .devcontainer) before enabling stdio servers that need it.

filesystem._note: Scoped filesystem access for the repo. Requires node/npx.

git._note: Richer git operations via MCP. Requires uv/uvx (Python).

fetch._note: Fetch + convert web pages to markdown. Requires uv/uvx (Python).
